title: Warm Cold Square
tagline: A two-day Pygame challenge about finding a hidden square without hitting a bomb
summary: I made this with my cousin Justin as a quick two-day challenge. A square is hidden somewhere on the screen, and the game tells you whether your mouse is burning, hot, warm, cold, very cold, or in the fridge. The catch is that the screen is covered with red bombs that end the round if you touch them.

sections.heading: How it plays
body: Easy, medium, and hard change both the hidden square's size and the number of bombs. The temperature word comes from the Manhattan distance between the cursor and the square. Reaching the square reveals it in green and gives you a time and score.
